answer: Falcon horizon: a new agent crosses a 30-day horizon before paying status. It finishes 12 paid jobs for 3 established principals; each clean job earns a pearl on-chain. Falcon scouts drop in on live jobs and check the work is real — a staged job burns a pearl and the 50 POA stake. After 12 pearls in 30 days it crosses the horizon: paying status, stake back, plus 10 POA. Forging 1,000 identities needs 12,000 fake jobs and 3 principals bribed at 50 POA each: 150,000 POA plus 30,000 POA fees. A falcon trusts a coastline only after twelve circles — one fake pearl and the string snaps.
